startingCard.title: Amy Winehouse dies
startingCard.subtitle: British singer-songwriter
startingCard.fact: Amy Jade Winehouse was a British singer, songwriter, musician, and businesswoman.

cards.title: Leopold II of Belgium becomes King of the Belgians
cards.fact: Leopold II was the second king of the Belgians from 1865 to 1909, and the founder and sole owner of the Congo Free State from 1885 to 1908.

cards.title: Cao Pi becomes Emperor of China
cards.fact: Cao Pi, courtesy name Zihuan, was the first emperor of the state of Cao Wei in the Three Kingdoms period of China.

cards.title: ‘The Pinkprint’ is released
cards.subtitle: Album by Nicki Minaj
cards.fact: The Pinkprint is the third studio album by rapper Nicki Minaj.

cards.title: BMP-1 enters service
cards.subtitle: Soviet infantry fighting vehicle family
cards.fact: The BMP-1 is a Soviet amphibious tracked infantry fighting vehicle that has been in service from 1966 to the present.

cards.title: Battle of the River Plate takes place
cards.subtitle: Battle in American Theater
cards.fact: The Battle of the River Plate was fought in the South Atlantic on 13 December 1939 as the first British naval battle of the Second World War.

cards.title: Scuderia Ferrari is founded
cards.subtitle: Formula 1 team
cards.fact: Ferrari S.p.A, currently competing as Scuderia Ferrari HP, is the racing division of luxury Italian auto manufacturer Ferrari and the racing team that competes in Formula One racing.

cards.title: TeX is created
cards.subtitle: Programming or computer language
cards.fact: TeX, stylized as TeX, is a typesetting program that was designed and written by computer scientist and Stanford University professor Donald Knuth and first released in 1978.

cards.title: Gunnar Nordahl dies
cards.subtitle: Swedish association football player
cards.fact: Nils Gunnar Nordahl was a Swedish professional footballer.

cards.title: Władysław IV Vasa becomes King of Poland
cards.fact: Władysław IV Vasa or Ladislaus IV was King of Poland, Grand Duke of Lithuania and claimant of the thrones of Sweden and Russia.

cards.title: Middle Ages begins
cards.subtitle: Historical era
cards.fact: In the history of Europe, the Middle Ages or medieval period lasted approximately from the 5th to late 15th centuries, comparable with the post-classical period of global history.

cards.title: Cary Grant dies
cards.subtitle: British-American actor
cards.fact: Cary Grant was an English-American actor.

cards.title: ‘CNN’ launches
cards.subtitle: Website
cards.fact: The Cable News Network (CNN) is an American multinational news media company and the flagship namesake property of CNN Worldwide, a division of Warner Bros.

cards.title: ‘New York Post’ launches
cards.subtitle: Newspaper
cards.fact: The New York Post (NY Post), founded as the New York Evening Post (originally New-York Evening Post), is an American conservative daily tabloid newspaper published in New York City.

cards.title: May Coup takes place
cards.subtitle: Coup d'etat
cards.fact: The May Coup was a coup d'état carried out in Poland by Marshal Józef Piłsudski from 12 to 14 May 1926.

cards.title: Battle of Narva takes place
cards.subtitle: Battle in Great Northern War
cards.fact: The Battle of Narva on 30 November 1700 was an early battle in the Great Northern War.

cards.title: ‘TLC’ launches
cards.subtitle: TV channel
cards.fact: TLC is an American premium multinational cable and satellite television network owned by the Networks division of Warner Bros.

cards.title: ‘Redeemer of Souls’ is released
cards.subtitle: Album by Judas Priest
cards.fact: Redeemer of Souls is the seventeenth studio album by English heavy metal band Judas Priest, which was released in the US on 8 July 2014, in Europe on 11 July, and in the UK on 14 July.

cards.title: Sanae Takaichi becomes prime minister of Japan
cards.fact: Sanae Takaichi is a Japanese politician who has been Prime Minister of Japan and President of the Liberal Democratic Party (LDP) since October 2025.

cards.title: New Synagogue Berlin is completed
cards.subtitle: Synagoge in Berlin
cards.fact: The New Synagogue on Oranienburger Straße in Berlin is a mid-19th century synagogue built as the main place of worship for the city's Jewish community, succeeding the Old Synagogue which the community outgrew.

cards.title: Roman Republic is established
cards.subtitle: Historical state
cards.fact: The Roman Republic was the era of classical Roman civilisation beginning with the overthrow of the Roman Kingdom and ending in 27 BC with the establishment of the Roman Empire following the War of Actium.

cards.title: ‘Jujutsu Kaisen’ begins
cards.subtitle: Japanese manga series
cards.fact: Jujutsu Kaisen is a Japanese manga series written and illustrated by Gege Akutami.

cards.title: ‘Discogs’ launches
cards.subtitle: Website
cards.fact: Discogs is an online database and marketplace for audio recordings, including commercial releases, promotional releases, and bootleg or off-label releases.

cards.title: Ryan X-13 Vertijet first flies
cards.subtitle: Aircraft by Ryan Aeronautical
cards.fact: The Ryan X-13 Vertijet is an experimental tail-sitting vertical take-off and landing (VTOL) jet aircraft built by Ryan Aeronautical and flown in the United States in the 1950s.

cards.title: ‘Honeymoon’ is released
cards.subtitle: Album by Lana Del Rey
cards.fact: Honeymoon is the fourth studio album by American singer-songwriter, and record producer Lana Del Rey.

cards.title: Lion Monument is created
cards.subtitle: Memorial in city of Lucerne, Switzerland
cards.fact: The Lion Monument, or the Lion of Lucerne, is a rock relief in Lucerne, Switzerland, designed by Bertel Thorvaldsen and hewn in 1820–21 by Lukas Ahorn.

cards.title: Herman Melville dies
cards.subtitle: American writer and poet
cards.fact: Herman Melville was an American writer of the American Renaissance period.

cards.title: ‘Erin Brockovich’ is released
cards.subtitle: Film directed by Steven Soderbergh
cards.fact: Erin Brockovich is a 2000 American biographical legal drama film directed by Steven Soderbergh and written by Susannah Grant.

cards.title: Emperor Taizong of Tang becomes Emperor of China
cards.fact: Emperor Taizong of Tang, previously Prince of Qin, personal name Li Shimin, was the second emperor of the Tang dynasty of China, ruling from 626 to 649.

cards.title: Spanish Civil War begins
cards.subtitle: Conflict
cards.fact: The Spanish Civil War was fought from 1936 to 1939 between the Republicans and the Nationalist rebels.

cards.title: Abercrombie & Fitch is founded
cards.subtitle: American fashion retailer
cards.fact: Abercrombie & Fitch Co.
